description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for resolving plugin SDK paths, package roots, alias maps, and related configurations within the openclaw project. It manages plugin SDK alias resolution, package root detection, and module path determination.

classes.name: PluginSdkAliasCandidateKind
classes.description: Type representing possible alias candidate kinds: 'dist' or 'src'.

classes.name: LoaderModuleResolveParams
classes.description: Type defining parameters for module resolution, including optional module path, URL, current working directory, and resolution preference.

classes.name: PluginSdkPackageJson
classes.description: Type representing the structure of plugin SDK's package.json, focusing on 'exports' and 'bin' fields.

methods.name: resolveLoaderModulePath
methods.description: Resolves the module path from parameters or defaults to import.meta.url.

methods.name: readPluginSdkPackageJson
methods.description: Reads and parses the package.json file from a given root directory.

methods.name: isSafePluginSdkSubpathSegment
methods.description: Checks if a subpath segment is safe based on a regex pattern.

methods.name: listPluginSdkSubpathsFromPackageJson
methods.description: Lists subpaths from package.json exports that start with './plugin-sdk/' and are safe.

methods.name: hasTrustedOpenClawRootIndicator
methods.description: Determines if a package root has indicators of a trusted openclaw root, such as specific exports or files.

methods.name: readPluginSdkSubpathsFromPackageRoot
methods.description: Reads plugin SDK subpaths from a package root if it is trusted.

methods.name: resolveTrustedOpenClawRootFromArgvHint
methods.description: Resolves a trusted openclaw root directory based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: findNearestPluginSdkPackageRoot
methods.description: Finds the nearest plugin SDK package root directory up to a maximum depth.

methods.name: resolveLoaderPackageRoot
methods.description: Resolves the package root for a loader module, considering various hints.

methods.name: resolveLoaderPluginSdkPackageRoot
methods.description: Resolves the plugin SDK package root based on current directory, hints, and nearest roots.

methods.name: resolvePluginSdkAliasCandidateOrder
methods.description: Determines the order of alias candidates ('dist' or 'src') based on resolution preferences and module path.

methods.name: listPluginSdkAliasCandidates
methods.description: Generates a list of candidate paths for plugin SDK alias files based on module path and resolution order.

methods.name: resolvePluginSdkAliasFile
methods.description: Finds the first existing plugin SDK alias file from candidate paths.

methods.name: listPluginSdkExportedSubpaths
methods.description: Lists exported subpaths from plugin SDK, with caching.

methods.name: resolvePluginSdkScopedAliasMap
methods.description: Builds a scoped alias map for plugin SDK subpaths, with caching.

methods.name: resolveExtensionApiAlias
methods.description: Resolves the alias path for the extension API, considering resolution order and existing files.

methods.name: buildPluginLoaderAliasMap
methods.description: Builds a map of plugin loader aliases, including extension API and plugin SDK paths.

methods.name: resolvePluginRuntimeModulePath
methods.description: Resolves the path to the plugin runtime module, considering resolution order and existing files.

methods.name: buildPluginLoaderJitiOptions
methods.description: Builds options for Jiti loader, including alias mappings.

methods.name: shouldPreferNativeJiti
methods.description: Determines if native Jiti should be preferred based on module extension and environment.
